lead.zh: 将原理词条与论文卡交替阅读。每篇都记录研究问题、证据设置和适用边界；未披露的部分保留为未知。
lead.en: Alternate concepts and paper cards. Record each research question, evidence setup and scope; leave undisclosed details unknown.

steps: 论文卡-Attention Is All You Need

zh: 把一份技术报告的训练章节拆成预训练/后训练两段，各说出关键变量
看到「刷新 SOTA」的说法，先查评测集发布时间和训练截止日期的关系
读模型卡时能指出许可证、评测口径和已知局限三处关键信息
对路线里的论文卡，各说出研究问题与核心证据位置，并说出至少一条「论文没有主张」的流行说法
en: Split a tech report's training section into pretraining and post-training, naming the key variables of each
On seeing a "new SOTA" claim, first check the benchmark's release date against the model's training cutoff
When reading a model card, point out the license, the eval setup, and the stated limitations
For each paper card on this route, state its research question and where the core evidence sits, and name at least one popular claim the paper never makes

answers.zh: 区分基础训练、监督数据和偏好优化，记录数据来源、目标函数与评测设置；技术报告没有披露的配方应标为未知，不按常见流程补写。
answers.en: Separate base training, supervised data and preference optimization. Record data sources, objectives and evaluation setup; leave undisclosed recipe details unknown.

answers.zh: 对照题集公开时间、训练截止、基准版本与去重说明。时间重叠只能提示污染风险，不能单独证明泄题；还需看污染检查和未见任务表现。
answers.en: Compare dataset release, training cutoff, benchmark version and decontamination. Temporal overlap suggests risk, not proof of contamination; inspect checks and held-out tasks.

answers.zh: 分别记录有实验支持、设置受限与未披露的项目。例如，模型卡只报告英文结果时，不推断中文表现或生产可靠性。
answers.en: Separate experimentally supported, setup-limited and undisclosed claims. English-only model-card results do not establish Chinese performance or production reliability.

answers.zh: 示例：LIMA 研究少量高质量指令数据的作用，查看其受控人评与消融；不能据此声称少量数据能解决所有安全与鲁棒性问题。其他论文同样对应问题、证据和适用边界。
answers.en: For LIMA, inspect controlled human evaluation and ablations on small high-quality instruction datasets. This does not establish that little data solves every safety or robustness problem. Apply the same question/evidence/limits structure to other papers.

nextTask.zh: 选一篇论文完成问题、证据与局限记录
nextTask.en: Read a paper into a question/evidence/limits record
